phase_step: one deterministic strict coordinate sweep over phase/support states using the exact bivariate factor objective
amplitude_step: alternate exhaustive exact integer minimization of q_p holding q_h and q_h holding q_p until coordinate-stable
limits: at most 16 outer rounds, 8 amplitude-coordinate cycles per round, or 300 seconds; one process; no restart or seed
stopping_rule: a complete phase sweep has zero moves and both amplitude coordinates remain fixed
promotion: materialize only a strict exact improvement; request separate compressed typed-kernel recount
scope: remove the global-amplitude active constraint on the immutable d93 parent; fixed Z5 kernel and no parameter-family sweep
